header.title: How to Wire a Light with Two Switches
header.description: This guide provides step-by-step instructions on how to wire a light fixture using two 3-way switches, allowing you to control the light from two different locations.

steps.description: This step involves ensuring switch boxes and lightboxes are securely mounted and running Romex cable between them according to amperage requirements.
actions: Ensure plastic switch boxes and lightbox are properly affixed to studs or joist
Feed Romex cable through the boxes
Verify a cable comes up from the main power source in the lightbox
Determine cable type (14/2 or 12/2) based on circuit amperage
Run a length of 2-wire cable (black, white, and bare) between the lightbox and the first switch box
Run 3-wire Romex (red, black, white, and bare) between the first and second switch boxes
Ensure each cable extends at least 6 inches from the box

steps.description: This step involves preparing and connecting wires within a lightbox, ensuring proper grounding and connections to the light fixture and switch box.
actions: Check that the circuit is turned off at the breaker panel.
Double check with a voltmeter.
Strip off the insulation of both ends of Romex to free the 3 wires within.
Strip off 1 inch of insulation from each individual wire (2 black and 2 white) on both the cable from the source and that leading to the first switch box.
Connect the white wire from the source to the white wire or silver screw on the light fixture.
Twist the ground wires from both ends together.
Fasten the ground wires with a wire nut.
Wrap a small piece of black electrical tape at the end of the insulation on the white wire leading to the first switch.
Twist that wire and the black wire from the source together.
Fasten the twisted wires with a second wire nut.
Leave the black wire leading to the first switch alone for now.

steps.description: This step involves preparing and connecting wires within the first switch box to the switch and other wires.
actions: Strip 1 inch of insulation off each of the 5 wires in the first switch box (not including the 2 ground wires).
Mark the other end of the white wire (marked with black tape in the lightbox) with black tape.
Attach the white wire (marked with black tape) to the lower brass screw on the right side of the first switch.
Connect the black wire from the lightbox with the black wire leading to the second switch by twisting their ends together.
Fasten the twisted black wires with a third wire nut.
Connect the 2 ground wires with a fourth wire nut.
Mark the end of the white wire leading to the second box with black tape.
Connect the white wire (marked with black tape) to the screw on the left side of the switch.
Connect the red wire leading to the second switch to the top brass screw on the right side.

steps.description: Connect the wires to the second switch box according to the specified connections.
actions: Mark the other end of the white wire with black tape
Connect the white wire to the left side of the second switch
Connect the red wire to the top screw on the right side of the switch
Connect the ground wire to the screw attached to the switch box
Connect the black wire to the bottom screw on the right side

steps.description: Connect the black wire from the first switch box to the light fixture and test the switches.
actions: Connect the black wire leading to the first switch box to the light fixture
Turn the circuit back on
Check your work
Stuff the wire in the boxes
Secure the boxes inside
Install the faceplates
